title: Production-independent story tests
summary: Seven clarity questions to ask people unfamiliar with a pitch after a rough animatic, plus the global kill criteria that no technically clean render can rescue.
evidence_notes: Editorial guidance from the owner's guide, written after Taylor rejected BOXED IN's story quality. Its review methods (table read, silent animatic, owner storyboard choice) are proposed; nothing here is validated audience research. The guide calls these clarity tests, not statistically meaningful audience research.
